name: FFVV
// ownsCore: Belcorp owns core/. FFVV had no spacing, radius, motion or z-index scale of its own — Dimentions.kt is ~100 named literals (dp_117, dp_389, dp_991), not a scale — so there is nothing to reconcile and it simply adopts core/.
// androidNamespace: Must differ from every other brand: two AARs sharing an R-class namespace produce duplicate R classes.
// extensions: Reserved x.ffvv.* namespace. Each entry is a value FFVV needs that the shared vocabulary cannot yet name. This list should only ever shrink — see docs/role-requests.md.

extensions.owner: TBD — needs programme sign-off, not design sign-off
extensions.reason: Consultant levels (diamond, gold, platinum, silver, bronce, pre-bronce). Consultoras models the same concept with 7 levels to FFVV's 6; the canonical set must be agreed before promotion.
Camino Brillante path colours (consultant, coral, ambar, perla, topacio, brigth). Collides by name with consultoras' app-camino-diamante; the overlap is real and must be reconciled.

Everything else FFVV needs that has no shared role yet: numbered escapes (state-error2/3, text-inactive2-6), surface layering (surface-third/four/five), selection states, gradients and single-app component colours. The numbered escapes are the first candidates to collapse.
